subject: Solvexa marketplace authority and listing matrix
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@solvexa.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intake: marketplace listing + visibility for Solvexa connector

Hi Markus,

Quick intro — I’m Amy, Head of Cloud Partnerships at Solvexa. We’re finalizing a productized connector to Redwood Inference and want to get it listed across AWS, GCP and Azure marketplaces.

Before we jump on a formal intake, can you confirm: who owns the marketplace "authoritative copy" for catalog descriptions (Redwood vs Solvexa)? Also:
- Which metering events do you typically require for co-sell SKU tagging?
- Is there an initial canary region we should target for the first public listing?

We’re targeting a soft launch in mid-April and would like to align on evidence we need to submit (perf numbers, telemetry samples, security artifacts). Attaching a short overview of the connector (PDF).

Attachments: solvexa-onepager.pdf (PDF, 780KB)

Thanks — can Ben or Markus put us on the right intake checklist?

Best,
Amy Chen
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Solvexa Inc
amy@solvexa.com

From: markus_klein@redwood.com <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@solvexa.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-02T10:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intake: marketplace listing + visibility for Solvexa connector

Hi Amy — great to meet you (virtually). Thanks for the one-pager. We own the catalog entry flow once a partner is approved, but the authoritative marketing copy is a joint responsibility: we publish from our console after sign-off from your GTM and legal teams. For intake, the minimal evidence set we need is below; I’ve also dropped a draft listing matrix in Drive for you to populate: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cSolvexaListingMatrix

Required for marketplace listing (initial intake):
- Architecture diagram (component boundaries + auth flows)
- Sample telemetry / usage CSV (representative 7–14 day sample)
- Performance profile (99th P95 token latency for a sample prompt)
- Security evidence (SOC2 summary or equivalent, contact for audit logs)
- SLA & support contact for customers

For co-sell SKU tagging specifically, we need a mapping from your product SKUs to the marketplace metering event. Please fill the SKU / Metering column in the matrix; we’re looking for a clear event name (e.g., "inference.tokens" or "connector.calls") and sample payload.

Canary region suggestion: us-east-1 is our preferred first region (largest customer coverage and co-sell enablement cadence). We can stage GCP (us-central1) second.

Next steps: 1) Can you upload the architecture diagram + sample telemetry to the Drive folder? 2) We’ll run a quick internal technical validation (Olga will own) and 3) Ben will scope commercial entitlements and pricing commitments.

I’ll propose a 30-min sync — next week TUE/WED window?

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.com <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Amy Chen <amy@solvexa.com>, markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Date: 2028-03-03T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intake: marketplace listing + visibility for Solvexa connector

Amy — quick add from the commercial side. For a co-sell entitlement and the co-sell tag on the listing we typically require:
- 30-day usage trial data showing customer activation (sample events ok)
- Support SLA: minimum 99.9% for connector uptime for marketplace entitlements; we can discuss 99.95% for priority partners
- Pricing commitment window: 90 days for any intro promotional pricing tied to co-sell campaigns

On the SKU mapping: we prefer a single canonical SKU per marketplace (publisher SKU) and then map any variant SKUs at your end. That avoids meter fragmentation. If you want, we can review the SKU mapping with our catalog team during the intake call.

If Solvexa wants joint PR / joint webinar at launch, we can allocate a small joint-MQL budget — scope depends on your ARR commitment level for the first 12 months.

Cheers,
Ben Carter
Sr. Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Amy Chen <amy@solvexa.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, Market Ops <marketops@solvexa.com>, Solvexa Legal <legal@solvexa.com>
Date: 2028-03-04T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intake: marketplace listing + visibility for Solvexa connector

Thanks Markus & Ben — attaching the requested artifacts. A quick summary of what’s in the bundle:
- solvexa-architecture-diagram.pdf (public/private boundary + auth flows)
- solvexa-usage-sample.csv (10-day telemetry sample; event = "connector.requests")
- marketplace-evidence-bundle.zip (SOC2 summary, integration test report, support runbook)

We’ve also started the DocuSign for the publisher agreement: https://www.docusign.com/solvexa/agreements/ABC12345 (Solvexa legal is on the envelope). We’d prefer the canary to be in us-east-1 as you recommended — that fits our SaaS footprint.

A couple of questions from our ops team:
1) For the metering event payload, do you need specific JSON fields (we currently send {"request_id":..., "duration_ms":..., "tokens_in":..., "tokens_out":...})
2) Any special requirements for marketplace listing imagery (hero screenshots) beyond the usual 1200x600 and a short 100–150 word description?

Attachments: solvexa-architecture-diagram.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB); solvexa-usage-sample.csv (CSV, 42KB); marketplace-evidence-bundle.zip (zip, 11.8MB)

Best,
Amy Chen
Head of Cloud Partnerships | Solvexa Inc
amy@solvexa.com

Amy — received everything, thanks. Quick notes and owners so we’re aligned for the intake review: 

Action items (owners):
- Olga Petrov: validate the architecture diagram and telemetry sample against our catalog metering schema (Olga will post a short validation report in the Drive folder by EOD 3/7)
- Ben Carter: map commercial entitlements and propose publisher SKU (Ben will share a pricing/entitlement table)
- Markus Klein (me): coordinate listing copy sign-off and schedule the intake review with catalog & legal

Answers inline: 
1) Metering payload — your JSON fields look fine; we need request_id, duration_ms and tokens_* for mapping to our meter. Please include a short example event in the SKU matrix.
2) Imagery — hero 1200x600 + one 600x400 product screenshot is fine; short description 120–160 words is ideal (we’ll edit for style during the copy sign-off).

Canary region set: us-east-1. Target intake review: 2028-03-09 10:00 AM ET (30 min). Will send a calendar invite once Ben confirms availability.

Attached: redwood-internal-listing-checklist.xlsx (internal intake checklist stub)

If Solvexa legal needs a contact, cc your DocuSign envelope to legal@redwood.com and I’ll loop in our contracts lead. Looking forward to the intake review.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Partner Integrations
Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.com
